出生地: 加拿大,安大略省,多伦多市
简介: Keeya King was born in Toronto, Ontario, Canada. She is an actor known for Jigsaw (2017), Residue (2017), Private Eyes (2016), Anatomy of Assistance (2013), and Brown Girl In The Ring (2016). At a young age, she pursued a career in the arts studying at Lewis Baumander Acting Studio and Dean Armstrong Acting School.
